newPlatforms.canonicalName: CFUV 101.9 FM Digital Music Director Submission Route
newPlatforms.category: non-profit campus and community radio airplay
authorizedRoutes: Send a digital submission to music@cfuv.ca
Provide at least three unique tracks as MP3 files at a minimum of 320 kbps
Deliver the files through a downloadable link and include a proper track listing

eligibility.digitalAudioFormat: MP3 at a minimum of 320 kbps
eligibility.deliveryMethod: Download link through !earshot Distro, Dropbox, Google Drive, WeTransfer, Box, DISCO or equivalent
eligibility.physicalEligibility: Non-local physical submissions are not accepted

businessContact.name: CFUV Music Director / Troy Lemberg
businessContact.verification: The mailbox is published on both CFUV's official Music Submissions page and its first-party staff-contact page. Verification covered repeated first-party publication, valid syntax, official-domain alignment and explicit Music Director and submission purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level probe was performed.

newPlatforms.activityVerification: CFUV's official site exposes a live stream, a current weekly schedule and active show descriptions. Current programming includes electronica, hip-hop, reggae, dub, breakbeat, ambient, experimental, world music, amapiano, gqom, house and synthwave.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is free-first and the business mailbox is verified, but a human must confirm international eligibility, select a release with at least three unique tracks, prepare 320-kbps MP3 files and a stable download link, add a proper track list and useful biography, and send manually. Physical delivery is not authorized for a non-local MarcsMusic submission.

newPlatforms.canonicalName: CHSR-FM 97.9 Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
authorizedRoutes: Use the Music Director email route displayed in human-readable obfuscated form on CHSR's official submission page
Send digital MP3 files at a minimum of 320 kbps through a download link or email attachment
Mail or drop off playable CDs, LPs or cassettes to the published CHSR address

eligibility.digitalAudioFormat: MP3 at a minimum of 320 kbps

businessContact.name: CHSR Music Director
businessContact.verification: The role address is published in human-readable obfuscated form on both CHSR's official submission page and first-party contact page, aligned to the official chsrfm.ca domain and explicit Music Director purpose. It was not machine-decoded or stored as plaintext. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level probe was performed.

formControls.adjacentFormExcluded: The form on the page is framed around sessions and interviews and was not used as a substitute for the Music Director route.

newPlatforms.activityVerification: CHSR's current site navigation still links the submission page, and the station published shows, playlists, archives and posts through July 2026, including electronic, remix, chiptune, experimental, global and hip-hop programming.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The guideline is legitimate and still linked, but it is marked last updated March 2023 and the Music Director route is intentionally obfuscated. A human must open the first-party page, manually use the displayed role route, choose a current delivery method, prepare 320-kbps MP3 files, include a clear track list plus artist, genre, location and contact information, and send manually. Do not use the adjacent sessions, PSA or general-contact routes as substitutes.

deduplication.result: Repository code searches returned no prior canonical CFUV or CHSR submission opportunity. CFUV's submission and contact pages were consolidated into one digital email record. CHSR's digital email and physical-delivery methods were consolidated into one record, while its sessions, PSA and general-contact routes were excluded.

notes: Both routes are free-first and manual-review only. CFUV publishes a verified plaintext Music Director mailbox and requires at least three unique 320-kbps MP3 tracks through a download link; international eligibility is not explicit and non-local physical music is rejected. CHSR publishes its Music Director route in human-readable obfuscated form, accepts 320-kbps MP3 by link or attachment and authorizes physical media. No email, form, file, link, package, login, CAPTCHA, payment or anti-bot control was submitted or bypassed.
